topic: The reject tax — only 17% of sites make reject-all as accessible as accept

drafts.text: AUDIT LOG: 2024 study on cookie disclaimers — only 17% of sites offer an option to reject all non-necessary cookies as easily accessible as accepting. The other 83%: refusal costs more than consent. Access denied is not ethics. https://data-snack.com/snack/cookie-roulette
